command: node --input-type=module -e import fs from "node:fs";import {createHash} from "node:crypto";import assert from "node:assert/strict";import {checkBaselines,checkGate} from "./scripts/verify-task.mjs";const dir="quality/evidence/CHATCRYPTO-BE",ledger=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("quality/tasks.json")),baseline=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("quality/spec-baseline.json")),before=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(dir+"/before.json")),task=ledger.tasks.find(t=>t.id==="CHATCRYPTO-BE"),hash=p=>createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest("hex");assert.equal(hash("scripts/verify-task.mjs"),before.readonly["scripts/verify-task.mjs"]);const count=checkBaselines({root:process.cwd(),baseline});let reason="",accepted=false;try{checkGate({root:process.cwd(),tasks:ledger.tasks,id:task.id,specHash:hash("../.doc/01-product-spec.md")});accepted=true;}catch(error){reason=error.message;}assert.equal(accepted,false);assert.equal(reason,"spec baseline changed");assert.equal(task.status,"IN_PROGRESS");for(const old of before.historical)assert.deepEqual(ledger.tasks.find(t=>t.id===old.id),old);const result={recordedAt:new Date().toISOString(),task:task.id,documentHashesVerified:count,stockCheckerUnchanged:true,stockGateAccepted:accepted,reason,backendSpecSha256:task.specSha256,currentSpecSha256:hash("../.doc/01-product-spec.md"),historicalPassRowsUnchanged:before.historical.length,banProducerTask:task.banProducerDecision.implementationTask,banProducerAcceptanceSatisfied:task.banProducerDecision.acceptanceSatisfied,backendComplete:false};const file=dir+"/stock-spec-snapshot-review.json";assert(!fs.existsSync(file));fs.writeFileSync(file,JSON.stringify(result,null,2)+"\n");console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
